connector.name: agentcentral
connector.registryDescription: Hosted Amazon Seller Central and Amazon Ads MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.agentcentral.to over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace to.agentcentral, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer agentcentral API key, for example: Bearer ac_live_<YOUR_API_KEY>
